summary: Tested AYMAFIN iteration 2 (3 new features on top of MVP): (1) localization of recommendations + activity log in EN/AR, (2) bank-specific PDF templates (generic/bna/bea/cpa/badr), (3) admin dashboard at /admin with stats/users/delete. Backend: 30/30 pytest tests PASS (extended iter1 file with TestBanks, TestBankPdf, TestAdmin classes). Note iter1 brute-force lockout test now also PASSES — main agent fixed it. Frontend: admin login redirects to /admin (NOT /onboarding); admin-page/admin-stats/admin-users-table/side-admin testids present; self-delete button disabled; non-admin testuser redirected from /admin → /dashboard with no side-admin entry; Reports page shows all 5 bank-option-{code} testids and selecting BNA + downloading produced 'aymafin-bna-<id>.pdf'; AR language switch flips html.dir to rtl and renders Arabic recommendations + activity log (verified visually via screenshot — sidebar/cards/recos/activity all in Arabic).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 840 lines — getting close to the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers (auth, business, analysis, reports, admin, chat) and a separate pdf_builder module.
_build_pdf is a single ~110-line function that mixes layout + i18n + bank theming; could be split into _pdf_header(bank, lang), _pdf_kpi_table(...), _pdf_forecasts_table(...) for testability.

/api/admin/users iterates users and runs N+1 count_documents (reports + chats) per user. For 1k+ users this becomes slow. Replace with two aggregate $group pipelines (one on reports, one on chat_history) and merge by user_id.
/api/reports/{id}/pdf falls back silently on invalid bank/lang — consider returning the chosen-vs-requested in a header (e.g. X-Bank-Used) so the UI can show a notice.
Admin delete is hard-delete with cascade; consider a soft-delete (deleted_at) for audit/compliance, especially for financial data.
